falas.txt: So here's what to do with your three numbers.
Three days a week. Ten minutes.
Hang from the bar three times. Stop a few seconds before your hands would slip.
Do three sets of push-ups. Stop two reps before you'd fail.
Then sit down on the floor and stand up, five times, using as much support as you need.
Each week, use a little less.
Week one, both hands. Week two, one hand. Week three, a hand on your knee. Week four, try it clean.
Don't train to failure. You're practicing, not punishing yourself.
Take a day off between sessions. Your hands and your tendons adapt slower than your muscles.
And write every session down. Three numbers, three times a week. It takes ten seconds.
